_comment: Reference copy, NOT symlinked. Claude Code rewrites ~/.claude/settings.json at runtime (/model, /config, plugin toggles), so linking it would fight the app. This holds only the half that never changes on its own and that wires up the scripts in this repo. On a fresh machine, merge these keys by hand into ~/.claude/settings.json. Deliberately omitted: model, enabledPlugins, extraKnownMarketplaces - work marketplaces and whatever model is current.
